name: Top Eleven
summary:
Top Eleven is a football management simulation that puts you in charge of your own club, from building and developing the squad to setting tactics and competing against other managers. Scout and sign players, train your team, manage club facilities, and make the decisions needed to guide your club through each 28-day season.

Matches take place in real time, with a 3D live match engine allowing managers to follow their team's performance and adjust tactics during games. Beyond the pitch, managers can develop their football campus, improve facilities, nurture young players through the Youth Academy, customize their club, and compete across the League, Cup, and other competitions.

Top Eleven also features extensive multiplayer interaction. Managers can compete against real opponents, create Friendly Championships, and join Associations with other managers to participate in cooperative weekend tournaments. Seasonal events, special challenges, player collections, and collaborations with real-world football legends continually expand the management experience.
